citation: Kerelsky et al., "Maximized electron interactions at the magic angle in twisted bilayer graphene", Nature 572, 95 (2019); arXiv:1812.08776v2 ("Magic Angle Spectroscopy")
license: arXiv.org perpetual non-exclusive license; facts and numbers only
topic: Scanning tunnelling spectroscopy on the AA sites of twisted bilayer graphene measures the two van Hove singularity (vHs) peaks of the flat bands at twist angles from 3.48° down to 0.79°.

facts.text: The separation between the two vHs peaks falls steadily as the twist angle decreases: it is still about 55 meV at 1.10°, and the peaks have nearly merged (13 meV) at 0.79°.
The half-width of each vHs peak is smallest near 1.10°; at 0.79° the peaks are closer together but wider.
Superconductivity and correlated insulators are seen in transport at about 1.1°.
facts.locator: Introduction; p. 4 (the angle where superconductivity is observed)

facts.text: A second near-magic-angle sample with a different heterostrain (0.6 %) shows a similar vHs splitting, and a tight-binding model with the experimental Fermi velocity reproduces the measured splittings.

ask: Which explanation of why correlated states appear near 1.1° is consistent with all of these observations?

hypotheses.text: The bandwidth of each individual vHs is smallest near 1.1°, so the ratio of Coulomb repulsion to bandwidth (U/t) is largest there, favouring electronic rather than phonon-driven pairing.
hypotheses.locator: p. 4 and Discussion (p. 7): width minimized near 1.10°; superconductivity where U/t is largest
hypotheses.reason: 与全部观测一致，即原文结论。

hypotheses.text: The two vHs peaks merge into a single density-of-states maximum at the superconducting angle.
hypotheses.locator: p. 3: two distinct peaks 55 meV apart at 1.10°
hypotheses.reason: 1.10° 时两峰仍相距约 55 meV，并未合并。

hypotheses.text: Phonon-mediated pairing, so correlated states follow the largest density of states, which occurs where the peaks merge (about 0.8°).
hypotheses.locator: Discussion (p. 7): phonon scenarios favour maximal DOS; observed at ~1.1°
hypotheses.reason: 态密度最大处在两峰几乎合并的 0.79°，而超导出现在约 1.1°。

hypotheses.text: The 55 meV vHs splitting at 1.1° is an artefact of heterostrain and does not reflect the band structure.
hypotheses.locator: Supplement S4: similar splitting at different strain; reproduced by tight binding
hypotheses.reason: 不同应变的样品劈裂相近，紧束缚模型也能重现，排除应变假象。

scale.definition: 莫尔晶胞（1.10° 时约 13 nm）
